sensitivity.description: At least two (tau, m) pairs. The sweep must contain the declared pair and must contain m=2 and m=3.

m.description: Top of the degraded band as a multiple of tau. Declared by the party that declares tau. EEO default is 3, and using that default must be stated here rather than hidden in the method.

m_origin.description: Who chose m. eeo_default means the record uses EEO default 3 and says so.

clock_model.description: EEO's own clock model: it runs inside this module, borrows the field conventions of public timing work, and carries no runtime dependency on any external tool or service.

observation_sha256.description: Hash of the clock observation the counts were taken from; required when sync is verified.

self_check.description: Known-ground-truth fault injection the clock model must pass before a record may claim verified sync.

runner.description: Executable fixture driver under tools/; the self-test calls it.

coverage.description: Injected fault classes; at least one case per class.

zh.const: 本核验只核验记录时间线自洽，不认定采集时物理同步。

en.const: This review checks that the recorded timeline is self-consistent; it does not certify that the sensors were physically synchronised at capture.

n_exact_copies.description: Byte-identical copies, counted regardless of W. A subset of n_duplicate_copies.

calibration_fixture_id.description: Fixture id when a real calibration exists; null while calibration_status is not_established.

metric.description: Fixed by EEO in the method. The buyer declares W, never the metric.

calibration.description: Known-truth calibration of the dedup detector, only when one exists. Null while calibration_status is not_established.

calibration_status.description: Whether a real detector calibration exists. not_established means no detector and no gate; calibration must then be null.

chain.description: The four-step chain, printed as fields: raw is n_declared, then sync_filtered, dedup_count, nees.

value.description: The bound itself, i.e. the number the buyer sees when capped.

formula.description: The formula that produced value, so the bound can be recomputed.

rho.description: The rho used in the bound.

diagnostics.description: Separate diagnostic readings, each with its own basis. They are not parts of NEES and do not sum to it.

en.const: No standard is cited as a basis for this record. The dimension split of YD/T 6771-2026 informed the thinking behind this module's own five dimensions; those dimensions are defined independently and form no mapping to it. Its clauses and thresholds are not cited, and nothing here asserts conformity with it or with any other standard.

zh.const: 本记录不以任何标准为判定依据。YD/T 6771—2026 的维度划分仅作为思路参考；本模块的五个维度独立定义，与该标准不构成对照关系。不引其条款与阈值，也不声明与该标准或任何其他标准相符。

buyer_summary_use_limitation.description: The same EEO-DUL-2 text, printed at the top of the buyer summary page.

formula.description: Exact one-sided 95% upper bound for zero failures: 1 - 0.05^(1/n_ind).
